summary: Customers should pay a 20 percent deposit when they book. This touches the booking form, the Paystack charge and the admin booking list.

criteria.text: On the booking page the customer sees the deposit amount, equal to 20 percent of the service price, before they pay.
After a successful deposit the customer sees Booking confirmed and the admin page lists the booking as paid.
If the card is declined, the customer sees a clear message and the time slot stays free for others.
If the customer presses Pay twice, only one deposit is charged and only one booking is created.

findings.title: Booking shows as confirmed before the deposit is checked
findings.plain: The booking is saved as confirmed before the Paystack result is known, so a declined deposit still leaves a confirmed booking.
findings.costIfIgnored: Unpaid bookings block real customers from the slot.
findings.fixPrompt: Save the booking as pending, and confirm it only after the Paystack payment is verified on the server.

findings.title: Deposit amount is not defined in the request
findings.plain: The request says customers pay a deposit but does not say how the amount is worked out.
findings.costIfIgnored: The coding agent will guess the amount and customers may be charged the wrong sum.
findings.fixPrompt: Compute the deposit as 20 percent of the service price on the server and show it to the customer before payment.
